chapter.verse: Abraham in Keturah min nei zi dang khat la hi.
Amah in tua nu tawh ta Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak leh Shuah nei hi.
Jokshan in Sheba leh Dedan’ pa ahi hi. Dedan’ tate in Asshurim, Letushim leh Leummim ahi hi.
Midian’ tate in Efah, Efer, Hanok, Abida, leh Elda-ah ahi hi. Hihte khempeuh in Keturah’ suan-le-khakte ahi hi.
Abraham in a neih khempeuh Isaak pia hi.
Ahih hangin Abraham in a zi-neu tawh a tate' tungah letsong pia a, ama' nuntak lai mahin nisuahna gam lamah ama' tapa Isaak kiang panin amaute sawlkhia hi.
Abraham, kum za leh kum sawm-sagih-le-nga a phak ciangin,
a nunung pen ama' hu sang a, a teek, kum tampi a pha, a khangham-in si a, ama' mite tawh kivui khawm hi.

Ama' tapate Isaak leh Ishmael in, Abraham in Hit mite' tung pan-a a lei lo, Mamre nisuahna lam-a om, Hit mi Zohar’ tapa Efron’ lo sung, Makpelah leihawm sungah amah vui uh hi. Tua lai mun-ah a zi Sarah tawh Abraham kivui hi.
Abraham’ sih khit ciangin Pasian in a tapa Isaak thupha pia hi. Be-erlahairoi-ah Isaak teng hi.
Hihte in, Abraham in Sarah’ numei-sila ahi, Izipt mi Hagar tawh a neih, Abraham’ tapa Ishmael’ suan-le-khakte' tangthu ahi hi.
Hihte in a suahna tawh kizui-in Ishmael’ tate’ min ahi hi; Ishmael’ ta upa in Nebaioth ahi hi; tua ciangin Kedar, Adbe-el, Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
Haddad, Tema, Jetur, Nafith leh Kademah ahi hi.
Hihte in a khua, a phual, a beh-in ulian sawn-le-nihte ahi Ishmael’ tate leh amaute’ min ahi hi.
(Ishmael, kum za leh kum sawmthum-le-sagih a phak ciangin a nunung pen ama' hu sangin si a, a behte tawh kivui khawm hi.)
Amaute Izipt nisuahna, Assiri lam Havilah panin Shur dongah teng uh hi; ama sanggamte khempeuh panin amah tuam ten’ hi.
Hihte in Abraham’ tapa Isaak’ suan-le-khakte tangthu ahi hi. Abraham in Isaak’ pa hi a,
Aram mi Laban’ Sanggamnu, Paddanaram gam-a Aram mi Bethuel’ tanu Rebekah zi-in a lak lai-in Isaak kum sawmli pha hi.
Isaak in Topa ’ tungah a zi adingin thungen hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amah ciing hi; Topa in ama' thungetna pia a, a zi Rebekah gai hi.
Ama' sungah a naute kilaigawp hi; amah in, ‘Hih bang ahih leh bang hangin nungta se ka hi hiam?” ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa ’ kiangah thu kan dingin amah pai hi.
Topa in ama kiangah, “Na gil sungah minam nih om hi, Nang’ sung pan a suak mihing nihte kikhen ding hi; khat in a dang khat sangin hatzaw ding hi, a u-zaw in a nauzaw’na sem ding hi,” ci hi.
Ama' suah ni hun a tun’ ciangin, en in, a gil sungah tapeeng om hi.
A masa pen a san-in hong suak a, a pumpi khempeuh mul a nei puan tawh kibang hi; tua ahih ciangin ama' min Esau phuak uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin a sanggampa hong suakkhia a, ama' khut in Esau’ khetul len hi; tua ahih ciangin ama' min Jakob kiphuak hi. Amau’ suah ciangin Isaak kum sawmguk pha hi.
Tua naupangte a khan’ ciangin, Esau in gamsung mi sabet siam khat hi a, Jakob in puanbuk sunga a teng a cingkam khat ahi hi.
Isaak in Esau it hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amah in ama' sa matsa ne hi; ahih hangin Rebekah in Jakob it hi.
Khat vei Jakob in meh huan hi, Esau gamlak panin hong ciahin phukhong vei hi.
Esau in Jakob kiangah, “Tua meh san tawm khat hong nesak in, bang hang hiam cih leh phukhong vei ing!” ci hi. (Tua ahih ciangin ama' min Edom kici hi.)
Jakob in, “Na innluahza hong pia lecin, tua meh kong pia ding hi,” ci hi.
Esau in, “A si ding ka hi ta hi; kei’ adingin innluahza bang-a kimang ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Jakob in, “Kei' tungah hong kiciam masa in,” ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama' tungah amah kiciamin, Jakob' tungah a innluahza zuak hi.
Tua ciangin Jakob in an leh bemeh Esau pia hi, amah in ne-in dawn a, dingin a pai nadingah pai hi. Tua ahih manin Esau in a innluahza tua bang ciang bekin ngaihsun hi.
